prompt:
Larder now serves two kitchens. Add sites as schema 3:
- Every location belongs to a site (`site` on each location) and the data has a `sites` list. Existing locations belong to site `main`. Add a second site `annex` ("Annex kitchen") with one location `annex-fridge` ("Annex fridge", 4 °C) to data/seed.json.
- A request names its site in the `X-Larder-Site` header; without it the site is `main`. An unknown site is a 400 error with its own error code.
- Batches, stock on hand, cooking, alerts, the stock value report and stock-takes only see the request's site. Items, suppliers, recipes and dishes are shared.
Older data files must still open. Update the tests that assume the old schema.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: Added sites as schema 3: a 2→3 migration puts existing locations in site `main`, the seed has the new `annex` site and `annex-fridge`, the X-Larder-Site header picks the site (default `main`, 400 `unknown_site` if it doesn't exist), and the site-specific features only see that site. npm test (33 pass) and npm run lint pass. Things to know: (1) data/db.json was left as it was; it still opens through the migration but has no `annex` site until you add it. (2) Temperature limits are still keyed by location id, so `annex-fridge` gets no fridge limit and no missing-check alert. (3) Some features you didn't list stay across all sites: the waste report, ledger export, forecasts and temperature logs. The nightly job is per site, so cron needs one call per site. (4) Receiving an order now only accepts locations in the request's site. (5) Without a site, domain functions and the CLI `value` command count every site. (6) Found but not changed: batch consumption uses newest-received-first instead of the FEFO rule in docs/DATA.md, and the stock value report rounds once per item instead of per batch line.

check.why: sites through storage, stock, cooking, alerts, reports, stock-takes and docs
